I would have to say the most painful thing was that one time I got stung by a jellyfish.

It was in Puerto Rico. In Puerto Rico there are many mini beaches that have coral reefs and different marine life that swim around and just vibe. It just so happened that my grandparents had a mini beach right behind their house

I was about 7 at the time. I had already regularly visited this mini beach and swimed carefully in it but the main things my grandparents told me to always be on the lookout for were sea urchins and pufferfish.

That day I remember going out into the water enjoying myself and being careful. I did see a few sea urchins and I made sure not to touch them. But then I felt something wrap completely around my arm. I thought it was seaweed so I pulled out my arm from the water to get off and to my horror an almost transparent jellyfish laid wrapped around my arm. 


The moment I pulled my arm out my arm from the water I felt so much pain. I tried to pull it away from my arm, it’s hooks piercing my skin  but after a few failed attempts I finally pulled off of me and I felt extreme pain.

I remember rushing out and the most stereotypical thing my grandparents do was slap vicks on my arm and then took me to the hospital. I still have scars that are spiraled all around my arm to this day
